name: Ashapura Minechem Ltd
title: Ashapura Minechem Ltd - 527001 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR5,237 crores (+91%) but Q4 EBITDA margin fell to about 11% as freight and bauxite prices corrected; management guides Q1 similar or worse and FY27 Guinea volume 10–12 Mt versus 15 Mt target.

summary.headline: Ashapura Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue rose 105% QoQ to INR1,969 crores, but management expects Q1 FY27 EBITDA similar to or below Q4 on falling bauxite prices and freight.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue from operations was INR1,969 crores versus INR960 crores in Q3, with EBITDA of INR211 crores (vs INR143 crores) and PBT before exceptional items of INR147 crores (vs INR89 crores). For FY26, revenue rose 91% to INR5,237 crores, EBITDA rose to INR674 crores from INR445 crores, and PBT before exceptional items rose to INR450 crores from INR305 crores. Management said Q4 EBITDA per tonne fell to $5.9 on ocean freight, fuel costs and lower bauxite prices, and guided Q1 FY27 to be similar to or weaker than Q4. The Board recommended a 100% dividend for FY26.

financial_highlights.change: Decline attributed to ocean freight, fuel and bauxite prices

segments.name: Guinea (bauxite)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue about INR4,200 crores with EBITDA of INR561 crores; bauxite exports about 8 million tons vs 3.5 million tons in FY25. Iron ore is still in commissioning and slower than planned.

segments.name: India (Bentonite & Allied Minerals, White Performance Minerals)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue about INR998 crores with EBITDA of INR112 crores. Margins hit by fuel, transport, input costs and a lower-margin product mix.

segments.name: Specialty Adsorbent Solutions (50% JV, Ashapura Perfoclay)
segments.commentary: Impacted by a sharp rise in sulfuric acid prices, a key raw material. No segment figures given.

segments.name: Advanced Ceramic Materials (Orient Ceratech stake)
segments.commentary: Delivered encouraging growth vs prior year. No segment figures given.

guidance_outlook: FY27 bauxite volume guided at 10-12 million tons, with 15 million tons targeted for FY28, contingent on freight, geopolitics and the quota system.
Q1 FY27 EBITDA expected to be similar to or a little worse than Q4 FY26; management expects the full FY27 EBITDA to be better than Q4 FY26 run-rate.
Management hopes FY27 EBITDA is better than FY26 but said clarity will come after the quota system is announced.
FY27 Guinea turnover guided at least about $700 million at about $70/t price; India expected to grow similarly to or slightly better than FY26, with EBITDA similar or slightly better.
Company focused on not increasing debt; debt reduction may come over the medium term as working capital rises with volumes.
India capex of about INR150 crores over the next year for plant upgrades and new products.
Boffa port capacity expansion from about 5 to about 10 million tons near completion; GSM port expansion targeted by end FY27-28; port capacity target of 27 million tons.
capex_capacity: Boffa port in Guinea being expanded from about 5 to about 10 million tons; described as on track and almost complete.
GSM port expansion to add 50-60% capacity, expected by end FY27-28.
Bauxite washing plant planned at 20,000 tonnes per day to upgrade non-marketable ore.

Iron ore beneficiation plant planned at north of 1.5 million tons; still at early due diligence, expected in 3-4 quarters. Capex may be handled by partners on a build-operate-transfer model rather than the balance sheet.
Seven new bentonite leases granted in the quarter to replenish India reserves.
demand_pricing: Management said bauxite CIF China rose from about $60 to $68-69/t, mainly due to freight increases on that route.
Aluminium metal trading near $3,600/t, expected to rise toward $4,000/t, supportive for bauxite demand.

Guinea government plans a bauxite quota system, possibly announced within the month; management expects exports to decline and net bauxite prices (bauxite minus freight) to improve after it, though details are not public.
Management said the company is a price taker and about 4% of Guinea's roughly 200 million ton export volume.
Long-term freight contracts with shipping lines held up during the quarter; talks under way with large shippers for longer-term freight arrangements.
India: value-added products in oil and gas and foundry; claimed about 35% India bentonite market share and over 40% of India's bentonite exports (to be verified).

qa_highlights.question: What is the Q4 FOB realisation and was there a further bauxite price drop?
qa_highlights.answer: Management pointed to the press release figure of $5.9 EBITDA per tonne in Q4; said bauxite prices fell in Q4 and Q1 may still be difficult.

qa_highlights.question: Will Guinea's quota system stall new mining releases, and is it positive for Ashapura?
qa_highlights.answer: Details are not public; management believes the quota is aimed at large players (70-80 million tons) and should be positive for Ashapura.

qa_highlights.question: Is Ashapura required to build local refining or smelting capacity in Guinea?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Ashapura's concessions carry no such terms, and no refinery or value-addition obligation exists today.

qa_highlights.question: Will Ashapura balance volume ramp-up against prices?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is a price taker, sees no near-term constraint from prices, and would change strategy only if freight became very volatile or vessels were unavailable.

qa_highlights.question: Is there capex on iron ore and bauxite beneficiation?
qa_highlights.answer: Models under evaluation with partners, including BOT; management aims to limit balance-sheet capex, nothing finalised.

qa_highlights.question: What are the FY27 revenue and EBITDA ballparks?
qa_highlights.answer: Guinea turnover of at least about $700 million at about $70/t; India flat to slightly better; EBITDA to be clearer after the quota system but hoped to be better than FY26.

risks_watch: Guinea quota system: timing, allocation and impact on volumes and net bauxite prices remain unknown.
Freight and fuel costs, linked to the geopolitical conflict, may keep margins under pressure through Q1 FY27 and the monsoon quarter.
Iron ore ramp-up is slower than planned, with the quarter-to-quarter timeline for contribution still open.
India margins under pressure from sulfuric acid, fuel and product mix; FY27 India growth guided only as stable.
Working capital build from volume ramp-up could delay debt reduction despite the stated aim of not increasing debt.
Port capacity expansion timing (GSM by FY27-28) gates the 15 million ton target.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the long-term Guinea story and quota upside, but cautious and hedged on near-term EBITDA. Management repeatedly said Q1 FY27 may be similar to or weaker than Q4 and gave few hard numbers on iron ore, capex and realisations, and deferred several questions until the quota details are out.
key_quotes: As you are aware that we have -- our top line has grown about 105%, and our -- the profit margin has gone 48% during this year.
we are optimistic that we are close to the bottom of the cycle, and pick-up would take us a little bit of time.
we are definitely currently more not focused on adding capex to our balance sheet as far as these projects are concerned.
We hope it will be better than this year, but time will tell.

adds.what: Boffa port expansion in Guinea from ~5 to ~10 million tons
Bauxite washing plant at 20,000 tonnes per day to upgrade non-marketable ore
Iron ore beneficiation plant, north of 1.5 million tons (early due diligence, may be BOT partner-funded)

growth.why: FY27 Guinea bauxite volume guided 10-12 Mt (vs ~8 Mt FY26) and Guinea revenue at least $700M, backed by Boffa port doubling to ~10 Mt by end Q2 FY27, but Q1 FY27 EBITDA guided similar to or below Q4 and India growth only similar to FY26, with the quota system outcome still pending.
